segments.text: Ok so this is the Pausing the Agent for Input page for Google Antigravity with Angular, and I'm reporting a problem on this page.
So this is the problem, the page talks about the backend agent pausing for input, but there's no backend code for it.
And it watches the default agent, which never interrupts.
This is my project, I've implemented the exact code from the doc.
This part, an agent that actually pauses, wasn't on the page, so I added it myself.
Moving on to the demo. With my agent the panel shows up, but only with review required and a cancel button, no title or choices.
So basically, the page never shows a backend that pauses, or what the interrupt payload looks like.
So you have to guess both.
So kindly look into it, thanks.
